title: Relative Smooth Surgery Structure Sets of Thickenings of the Cayley Projective Plane and Applications
summary: We compute the relative smooth surgery structure sets of the thickenings $\mathbb{OP}^{2}\times\mathbb{D}^{k}$ of the Cayley projective plane $\mathbb{OP}^{2}$ for every $k\geq 1$ with $k\equiv 0\pmod 4$, by determining the corresponding normal invariants and surgery obstruction map. We show that the latter is not surjective and determine the $2$-adic valuation of the generator of its image.
